::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 30th [1862]  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Katherine Wykes-Sneyd
:::

My dear [Irene](people/person_538.qmd),

Do you know your stamps never came out of your letter. I waited a day or two in case you had forgotten them and would find them out, but they are not forthcoming yet. I do not think I could have lost them in opening the letter. Many thanks for them all the same.

[Chelsea Delf](people/person_329.qmd) and you are the [winners](organizations/other_104.qmd) this time You for the compass

your affectionate

Mother Goose

Jany 2nd This letter got into another by mistake and has been to Edinburgh!
